        function he(e) {

        function ve(e) {

        }

        function ye(e) {

          return null !== (n = null == e ? void 0 : e.data) && void 0 !== n ? n : e
        }

        function ke(e) {
          if (e instanceof Date) return e.getTime();
          if ("number" == typeof e) return Number.isFinite(e) ? e : 0;
          if ("string" == typeof e) {
            var n = Number(e);
            if (Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0) return n;
            var r = Date.parse(e);
            return Number.isFinite(r) ? r : 0
          }
          return 0
        }

        function Ee(e) {

          return {
            createdAt: t,
